fullText:
方卿低头无语
只见姑娘含笑相迎
陈翠娥见表兄落魄
心中暗自伤情
这珍珠塔传家宝
权且赠与兄长作盘缠
望兄长一路珍重
早日功成名就
莫忘姑苏陈家情
方卿接塔谢不尽

translations.zhHant:
方卿低頭無語
只見姑娘含笑相迎
陳翠娥見表兄落魄
心中暗自傷情
這珍珠塔傳家寶
權且贈與兄長作盤纏
望兄長一路珍重
早日功成名就
莫忘姑蘇陳家情
方卿接塔謝不盡
translations.en:
Fang Qing lowers his head in silence
He sees the young lady greet him with a smile
Chen Cui'e sees her cousin in hardship
And feels secret sorrow in her heart
This Pearl Tower is a family heirloom
I give it to you, brother, as travel money
May you take care on the road
And soon succeed in your career
Do not forget the Chen family of Suzhou
Fang Qing accepts the tower with endless thanks

note: Starter text layer for archive: Pearl Tower gift scene, shaped as a Talcne→Yueyu export (OCR bridge). Educational reading sample; timings are synthetic until audio is curated.
